_doc: Single source of truth for every tag vocabulary in the scene packs. Namespaces: genre (venue era/mode pools; UI enums DERIVE from this registry at import — they cannot drift), facet (venue texture; may overlap freely), situation (action register on a situation), identity_age / identity_sex / identity_race (character identity axes; canonical values drawn through the roller's soft-affinity weighting). Adding a genre: add the id here, then tag venues honestly and give the genre two wardrobe families. Cross-tag honesty rule: a venue may carry genre G only if it is welcome in every pool built from G. _aliases holds legacy spellings accepted by validation — add no new ones. Unknown tags fail ComfyUI startup via scene_tags.validate_scene_tags(), naming the venue and the tag.

historical.desc: Real-world past, pre-20th-century texture. Actions stay era-neutral; props belong to the renderer.

sci_fi.desc: Engineered futures — spacecraft, colonies, advanced infrastructure.

fantasy.desc: Pre-industrial worlds where the impossible is ordinary — mythic cultures, invented orders.

western.desc: Frontier subgenre of historical — lawmen, ranches, border towns.

age_of_sail.desc: Wooden-ship maritime subgenre of historical — frigates, pirates, tall ships.

post_apocalyptic.desc: Collapse-aftermath subgenre spanning sci_fi and modern — ruined infrastructure, scavenger economies.

facet.sea: Open water or offshore; horizon and weather carry the frame.
facet.shore: Land-water edge: docks, beaches, harbor margins.
facet.vessel: Aboard a ship or boat; deck geometry, rigging, rails.
facet.age_of_sail: Wooden-ship maritime era (frigate, pirate). A facet today; genre-promotion is a batch-3 question.
facet.small_crew: A working crew of roughly 2-6; tight coordination.
facet.small_crowd: A handful of people; intimate scale, faces readable.
facet.crowd: Many people plausible; background density welcome.
facet.suburban: Suburban low-density edges: yards, strips, culs-de-sac.
facet.street: Street level: storefronts, foot traffic, doorways.
facet.road: A route through — travel, transit, passage.
facet.station: A fixed operating post — ranger or relay; outpost infrastructure.
facet.leisure: Recreation and pleasure — patrons, travelers, audiences rather than workers.
facet.interior: Under a roof — enclosed interiors: halls, holds, shelters, domestic rooms.

situation.calm_capable: Skilled action at ease; unhurried competence.
situation.tense_capable: Skilled action under strain; stakes present, motion contained.
situation.action: Kinetic verbs — movement carries the read.
situation.social: People interacting: talk, trade, bargain, gathering.
situation.nature: The environment acts — weather, terrain, animals.
situation.violent_capable: Combat-adjacent without stated gore; violence plausible, not depicted.

identity_age.young adult: Twenties band. Canonical spelling — legacy 'young' maps here via _aliases.
identity_age.middle-aged: Forties-to-sixties band. Zero tagged entries today — known coverage gap.

identity_sex.female: Sex axis for phrase agreement and soft affinities.
identity_sex.male: Sex axis for phrase agreement and soft affinities.

venue_archetype.interior_social: Indoor space built for gathering — taverns, mess halls, cantinas, concourses.
venue_archetype.interior_domestic: Indoor space built for dwelling or close quarters living.
venue_archetype.interior_industrial: Indoor working space — hangars, presses, greenhouses, engine rooms.
venue_archetype.exterior_natural: Outdoor space where terrain/weather dominates — forests, coastlines, mountain trails.
venue_archetype.exterior_built: Outdoor space shaped by construction — streets, docks, camps, yards.
